scope: Step5a Local Control / Teach Pendant no-contact cycloid semantics that ROS2 migrations must inspect before implementation and classify after implementation.

retired_provenance.notes: 15 s timing lineage with the same no-scale cycloid geometry.

cycloid_task_geometry.phase_semantics: theta is the cycloid path parameter; 2*pi is one cycloid arch in the formula, not TCP orientation and not a circular TCP path.

frame_map.physical_path_gate: Affine map exactly matches shifted drag-teach start/mid/end targets.

fixed_z_and_clearance.policy: fixed base Z, no contact search

corrections_and_caps.tp_v3_command_clamp_role: URScript command-vector clamp provenance only; it is not automatically a ROS2 achieved-speed hard gate.

endpoint_semantics.return_recovery_policy: Any ROS2 combo return is an operator recovery surface and must name its target explicitly.

ros2_migration_alignment_contract.preimplementation_gate: Before changing any UR10e migration/refactor/live-gated script for Step5a/Step5b lineage, Implementor MUST list the Local Control source scripts, stage table, safe-frame/correction artifacts, and relevant Auditor reports inspected.
ros2_migration_alignment_contract.completion_gate: Completion/handoff MUST include a Local Control Textbook Alignment table. Each field MUST be marked preserved, changed_with_reason, or out_of_scope.
ros2_migration_alignment_contract.frame_map_gate: If ROS2 uses safe-frame rotation instead of the TP v3 affine map, the artifact MUST mark it as changed_with_reason and name the reason. Silent replacement is a failure.
ros2_migration_alignment_contract.speed_gate: The TP v3 0.009 m/s command clamp MUST NOT be treated as a ROS2 achieved-speed hard gate unless the artifact explicitly names that as the route policy and justifies it.
ros2_migration_alignment_contract.return_gate: Combo return target MUST come from step5a_historical_fixed_z_position.json pre-cycle start_positions when the command is the historical fixed-Z cycle wrapper; it must not silently use path summary or an unrelated no_contact_test run.
